name: Terrasymbiosis
clause: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, you may draw that many cards. Do this only once each turn.

needs.proposedSignature: TriggerEvent: { on: 'counters-placed', counter?: string, filter?: Filter, who?: 'you' | 'any' }  with TriggerCtx.amount = how many were placed
needs.semantics: Fires when one or more counters of the named kind are put on a matching permanent, carrying the number placed as the trigger's amount so 'draw that many cards' reads it through { count: 'that-many' }. `addCounters` is the single choke point, so raising the event is local.
needs.clause: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, you may draw that many cards.
